## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed 237 captures during February 2021. Activity was undertaken as scheduled, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the site continued to provide a consistent service throughout the reporting period. No operational issue is noted other than the routine staffing arrangements described above.

## Image quality

Of the 237 captures, 12 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.1%. The ungradable images should be considered as part of the site’s overall image-quality monitoring. Continued attention to image acquisition and immediate review may help maintain the quality of future captures and identify any recurring issues promptly.

## Grading

A total of 40 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that grading was completed within a short interval for the reporting period, supporting timely review of results requiring further attention. The activity, image-quality and grading figures should be reviewed together when assessing the site’s operational performance.
